NOTE 1:
Typically, the procedures are aborted on the first expiry of the relevant timer. Exceptions are described in the specific procedures.
NOTE 2:
The value of this timer is network dependent. If ISR is activated, the actual value of this timer is a multiple of T3412.
NOTE 3:
This value shall be sent in ATTACH REJECT.
NOTE 4:

If the value of the timer is 2 minutes or less in T3212, T3502 is started when T3212 and the MME receiving the TRACKING AREA UPDATE REQUEST message or the ATTACH REQUEST message does not accept the UE to T3412. If there is no equivalent procedure in the 2G or 3G system as a procedure to provide UE with a shorter timer T3346, the value of this timer is not equivalent to T3412.
NOTE 5:
This timer shall only be started in the MME if the Attach Accept message or TRACKING AREA UPDATE ACCEPT message does not carry GUTI allocation or TAI list. Otherwise, the timer T3450 is started.
NOTE 6:

The value of the timer is used both for the value of T3412 and T3423 in TS 24.008 [13]. In case T3346 is running in the UE, the MME may set T3412 to 0 in the TRACKING AREA UPDATE ACCEPT or ATTACH ACCEPT message or SGST T3 [34] (T3212).
NOTE 7:
The MME should not start T3413 when the UE is in EMM-CONNECTED mode. If the UE is in EMM-CONNECTED mode, the maximum value of this timer is implementation.
NOTE 8:

With TS mode, if the UE supports CS mode (i.e. dual capability in either CS mode & i.e. CS mode & EPS), then the timer value is as reported in the table for the case of ISR (3 Gi=2 or lower (mode 0 and 1)).
NOTE 9:
If T3346 or T3442 is running in the UE, the MME may set the T3412 to "deactivated", using the NAS timer value which inhibits network signalling.
